sentences.en: The model introduced genetic algorism into SVM, so it can adaptively adjust kernel parameters of SVM and obtain exact image information.

sentences.en: For the algorism of temperature and moisture control, it makes profound analysis, puts forward a new algorism, and prominently improves the controlling quality.
sentences.vi: Đối với thuật toán kiểm soát nhiệt độ và độ ẩm, nó phân tích sâu sắc, đưa ra một thuật ngữ mới và cải thiện đáng kể chất lượng kiểm soát.

sentences.en: SOM algorism is implemented in the C ++ program. It's used for face image classification.

sentences.en: This paper presented a dart - cutting algorism, which grounded on the energy - based three - dimensional surface flattening.

sentences.en: And the plant specifics and control algorism are effectively discussed.

sentences.en: Therefore, the algorism is suited to be run in supervisory computer to supervise the condition of evaporators.

sentences.en: Important factors include the sampling rate, the zero point of pressure sensor, and the correct calibration of sensor, The revised program and algorism may improve the precision of measurement.

sentences.en: According to the characteristics of load system, the PID algorism is proposed.
